purpose: Summarize app-lane closed-shape lint schema advisories and carry CLI timeout boundary forward.

Cicero.key_contribution: Closed-shape fields, required fields, forbidden fields, enum constraints, and failure objects for coefficient/SI and metric-action rows.

Kierkegaard.key_contribution: Closed-shape boundary schema, forbidden proof/canon fields, failure objects, false-positive routes, and non-proof caveats.

Aristotle.key_contribution: Closed-shape schema fragments and failure objects for full scalar disablement, constraint mapping, and diagnostic-only coupling-to-zero.

synthesis_decisions: Create one closed-shape lint schema covering all row families.
Use additionalProperties:false as the target schema posture.
Require failure objects for every forbidden field, enum violation, missing required field, or overclaim.
Keep PASS_SCHEMA_ONLY limited to row-shape and guard completeness.
Keep all physics rows not_run and no_result.
Carry CLI timeout as workflow blocker without retrying long CLI calls in this phase.
